subject.title: refactor(pairing): store channel pairing state in SQLite

question: After the wildcard-account migration defect is fixed and live upgrade proof is supplied, should startup automatically migrate and remove recognized pairing authorization files while leaving ambiguous files fail-closed for operator repair?
rationale: This migration rewrites and removes persisted access-control state; accepting its automatic-upgrade and recovery semantics requires explicit ownership of the authorization boundary rather than only green tests.

options.title: Require corrected migration and live proof
options.body: Filter routing-only wildcard accounts, add focused upgrade coverage, and demonstrate a real pairing migration before accepting automatic source removal.

options.title: Limit migration to doctor
options.body: Keep startup non-mutating and require operators to run `openclaw doctor --fix` before the SQLite-only runtime takes effect.

options.title: Pause the storage cutover
options.body: Retain the existing runtime store until maintainers define a different upgrade and recovery contract.

recommendation.title: Require corrected migration and live proof
recommendation.body: Filter routing-only wildcard accounts, add focused upgrade coverage, and demonstrate a real pairing migration before accepting automatic source removal.

likelyOwner.reason: They own the current refactor and linked issue and are best positioned to confirm the intended authorization-state upgrade contract.
